name: heymarket-sms
label: Heymarket SMS
description: Heymarket is a business texting platform that gives you the power to engage with people using shared inboxes.

token.label: Heymarket API Key
token.description: Enter your Heymarket API Key. You can find it in your Heymarket account settings.

createOrUpdateContact.label: Create or Update Contact
createOrUpdateContact.description: Create a new contact or update an existing contact by phone number

phone.label: Phone Number
phone.description: Phone number in E.164 format without the plus sign (e.g. 14155553434)

is_opted_out.label: Is Opted Out
is_opted_out.description: Whether the contact is opted out of messaging

contact_id.label: Contact ID
contact_id.description: Contact ID for updating an existing contact. If not provided, will attempt to create a new contact

overwrite.label: Overwrite Custom Fields
overwrite.description: When true, replaces all existing custom fields. When false, merges with existing ones. Note: contact name is always overwritten

sendCustomMessage.label: Send Custom Message
sendCustomMessage.description: Send a custom text message to an individual contact or a list

inbox_id.label: Inbox ID
inbox_id.description: Unique identifier for the inbox from which the message will be sent

creator_id.label: Creator ID
creator_id.description: Unique identifier for the sender (member ID from Get Inboxes)

phone_number.label: Phone Number
phone_number.description: Phone number in E.164 format without the plus sign (e.g. 14155553434). Required if not sending to a list or chat

targets.label: Group Targets
targets.description: Array of phone numbers in E.164 format without the plus sign for group MMS messages

sendTemplateMessage.label: Send Template Message
sendTemplateMessage.description: Send a message using a template to an individual contact or a list

inbox_id.label: Inbox ID
inbox_id.description: Unique identifier for the inbox from which the message will be sent

creator_id.label: Creator ID
creator_id.description: Unique identifier for the sender (member ID from Get Inboxes)

template_id.label: Template ID
template_id.description: Unique identifier for the Heymarket template to send

phone_number.label: Phone Number
phone_number.description: Phone number in E.164 format without the plus sign (e.g. 14155553434). Required if not sending to a list

targets.label: Group Targets
targets.description: Array of phone numbers in E.164 format without the plus sign for group MMS messages

text.label: Message Text
text.description: Optional message text body to override or supplement the template

updateList.label: Update List
updateList.description: Update an existing list in your team by adding or removing members, or updating list properties

list_id.label: List ID
list_id.description: Unique identifier for the list to update

add_phone.label: Add Phone
add_phone.description: Phone number in E.164 format without the plus sign to add to the list (e.g. 14155553434)

remove_phone.label: Remove Phone
remove_phone.description: Phone number in E.164 format without the plus sign to remove from the list (e.g. 14155553434)

members.label: Members
members.description: Object of list targets. Keys are phone numbers, values are objects with optional first name (f) and last name (l)
